All four options are Japanese animated features, with supported distinguishing notes. It is close in template to #72 but asks a separate 2003 result.

BFI supports the prompt's Kaneda/Tetsuo former-friends conflict and supports that the manga is complete and narratively more cohesive than the film. It does not support the explanation's temporal claim that the film was made while the manga was still being serialized. One bounded fix: replace that unsupported explanation with the BFI-supported comparison (the manga's more cohesive SF narrative versus the film's adaptation/condensation), or attach an already-authorized direct source passage if one exists. Do not infer production timing from the film's 1988 date alone. This is the only content fix requested; no source retry is authorized.

Ghibli's official credits identify Joe Hisaishi as Spirited Away composer; the notes' Demon Slayer composers, Garden of Words composer, and Robot Carnival/Hisaishi facts match the supplied official/BFI contexts. Correct answer is unique. Medium is plausible but this promoted easy slot is explicitly provisional; genuine easy/key1 compensation is still required before applying.
